title: Executor describe
description: The executor's answer to describe, read by the describe preflight once the task's execution environment is live and before the first round, under the result-reader rules. Readers ignore unknown properties; a property is never renamed, retyped or removed within a protocol version. Implements FR4, FR13 of define-executor-contract.

protocolVersion.description: The contract version the executor speaks, bumped only on a breaking change. A version the factory does not speak is a located law error before the first round.

version.description: The executor's own version, recorded by the round that ran it.

roles.description: The roles the executor serves. Unknown-token arm: a role outside the set is ignored, so a use site needing it is refused as undeclared.

capabilities.description: Optional behaviours beyond start. Unknown-token arm: an unknown capability is ignored.

settingsSchema.description: A JSON Schema the law's settings for this executor are validated against before the first round.

credentials.description: The environment variable names of the credentials the executor needs; values reach its process by the environment channel only.

egress.description: The hosts the executor must reach.

configDirVariable.description: The environment variable naming the executor's configuration directory, when it has one.

policyDisablingFlags.description: The flags that disable the executor's repo-local policy sources.

enforcementLevel.description: How strongly the executor enforces the abstract policy, strongest first. Unknown-token arm: read as PROMPT_ONLY, the weakest level.

reportsUsage.description: Whether results carry REPORTED usage. An executor that reports none cannot serve a stage with a money bound.
